entries.title: Job 37:1
segments: My heart trembles at this also, and it leaps out of its place.

entries.title: Job 37:2
segments: Listen carefully to the thunder of His voice, and the rumbling that comes out of His mouth.

entries.title: Job 37:3
segments: He loosens it under the whole heavens, and His lightning to the ends of the earth.

entries.title: Job 37:4
segments: After it a voice roars; He thunders with the voice of His majesty, and He will not hold them when His voice is heard.

entries.title: Job 37:5
segments: God thunders marvelously with His voice; He does great things, and we do not understand.

entries.title: Job 37:6
segments: For He says to the snow, Fall [on] the earth; also to the shower of rain, and to the shower of [heavy] rains in its strength.

entries.title: Job 37:7
segments: He seals up the hand of every man, so that all men may know His work.

entries.title: Job 37:8
segments: Then the beast goes into its lair, and it remains in its dens.

entries.title: Job 37:9
segments: Out of the storeroom comes the tempest; and cold from scattering winds.

entries.title: Job 37:10
segments: By the breath of God ice is given; and the expanse of waters is frozen tight.

entries.title: Job 37:11
segments: Also He loads the clouds with moisture; He scatters the lightning cloud,

entries.title: Job 37:12
segments: and it is turned around by His guidance, so that they may do whatever He commands them on the face of the world in the earth.

entries.title: Job 37:13
segments: Whether as a whip, or for His land, or for mercy, He finds it.

entries.title: Job 37:14
segments: Listen to this, Job; stand still, and consider the wonderful works of God.

entries.title: Job 37:15
segments: Do you know when God placed them, and caused the lightning of His cloud to shine?

entries.title: Job 37:16
segments: Do you know the balancing of the clouds, the wonderful works of Him who is perfect in knowledge?

entries.title: Job 37:17
segments: You whose clothes warm when He quiets the earth from the south wind?

entries.title: Job 37:18
segments: Have you beat out the expanse with Him, hard like a cast mirror?

entries.title: Job 37:19
segments: Teach us what we shall say to Him; [for] because of darkness we cannot arrange our case.

entries.title: Job 37:20
segments: Shall it be told Him that I would speak? If a man speaks, surely he shall be swallowed up.

entries.title: Job 37:21
segments: And now men cannot look upon the light; it [is] in the clouds; but the wind passes and clears them.

entries.title: Job 37:22
segments: Golden [splendor] comes out of the north; God [is] awesome in His majesty.

entries.title: Job 37:23
segments: The Almighty, whom we cannot find out, [is] exalted in power; and to judgment and overflowing righteousness He does no violence.

entries.title: Job 37:24
segments: Therefore, men fear Him; He does not respect any [who are] wise in heart.
